brief: Two separate pairs of bases, the pairs joined to each other only with side connectors.

requirements.evidence: Four Hex bases placed as 2×2 grid: pair 1 = piece:0,0,0;full + piece:1,0,0;full joined by connector:0#0,0|1,0; pair 2 = piece:0,1,0;full + piece:1,1,0;full joined by connector:0#0,1|1,1

requirements.requirement: Pairs joined to each other only with side connectors
requirements.evidence: Inter-pair connections are side connectors: connector:0#0,0|0,1 (west edge bridging pairs) and connector:0#1,0|1,1 (east edge bridging pairs). No other joining methods used (no shared faces via placement adjacency alone, no other connector types). All checks clear, house rules applied (capOpenFaces, lockJoints with jointBolt:0#0,1#1).

finish.summary: Built a 2×2 cluster of four Full Hex bases as two defined pairs (0,0+1,0 and 0,1+1,1). Each pair internally joined by side-connector-double, and pairs joined vertically by side-connector-double on both west and east edges. Only side connectors used, verified with meshClash clear and caps/locks applied.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

lines.key: pvc-section-double  (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
